newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dekalb EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dekalb EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Thursday she raised her earnings estimates for DeKalb Genetics Corp for fiscal 1997 to $1.75 a share from $1.42 and for fiscal 1998 to $2.10 a share from $1.65.
-- Her third quarter 1997 estimate also was raised to $0.80 a share from $0.60.
-- Earlier, DeKalb, a seed and agricultural company, reported second quarter earnings of $0.91 a share, above the consensus of $0.77 a share and Dain's estimate of $0.78.
-- She reiterated her buy rating on the stock.

-- In a report, Wittenburg said she raised her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate based on expectations that DeKalb is gaining more than one percentage point in market share and based on margin benefits coming from sales of higher priced seed corn hybrids.
-- "DeKalb is in the enviable position of having good short- and long-term fundamentals," Wittenburg wrote in a report.
